text:
Removing operational recovery, raw browser DOM and the two exact parser-inventory study tags from derived retrieval removed 1,752,846 of 2,351,979 search sections. All 71,083 original records remained, and no lesson was archived.

The named inventory studies are architecture-study-20261013 and architecture-relationships-20261013. Other semantic studies, code evidence and task outcomes remain eligible. Archive membership changes default search and learning, not immutable files or citation targets.

Three same-order search samples in separate processes changed from 7.800/2.155/0.252 seconds to 6.354/1.130/0.236 seconds. The first query replaced copied recovery and browser results with commits and diffs. This small sample is not a general performance claim.

The changed recovery helper validated all 140 saved packets against 141 immutable IDs. Reference manifests totaled 225,136 bytes instead of copying 10,937,568 wrapper bytes. Missing or changed receipts fail visibly. Full originals remain available.

Validation: 62 relevant isolated tests, 5 helper tests and scoped ESLint passed. The Commands implementation is an uncommitted working-tree change at capture time. The shared consumer instructions are published at the reference above. No live console UI or fresh browser discussion was exercised. Physical Git evidence and database file size were not reduced; derived index rows were removed.
title: Measured cleanup of repetitive knowledge retrieval data
